verdict.rationale: Bulk actions on many mail items at once are a fair capability for a virtual mailbox service, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes per-item requests, such as asking the operator to scan, forward or shred a letter. Nothing documents multi-select, batch actions or programmatic bulk operations, and the API/OpenAPI probes returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
